title: A group's placement overrides are coord keys its own operators write, refused when they break the decision schema
goal: coord keeps a group's overrides as group/<group path>/policy/placement, one JSON object mapping an operation to {executor, identity, fallback, fallback_after_s, budget_cap_usd}; a put whose value is no such object (an unknown operation, executor, identity or fallback, a negative number) exits 2 naming the field, served or local; the write rule of group keys decides who may put it; coord.py get prints it back unchanged

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
kd=os.path.join(d,"keys")
def key(p,t):
    f=os.path.join(kd,*p.split("/")); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f),exist_ok=True); open(f,"w").write(t); os.chmod(f,0o600); return f
a=key("corp/ops/jan.kowalski","ka-placeholder"); b=key("corp/dev/anna.nowak","kb-placeholder")
EXTRA=[]
import atexit
sv=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd]+EXTRA,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True); atexit.register(sv.kill)
url=sv.stdout.readline().split("serving")[1].strip()
put=lambda k,v: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--url",url,"--key-file",k,"put","group/corp/ops/policy/placement","--value",json.dumps(v),"--revision","0"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60).returncode
ok={"check":{"executor":"server","identity":"none","fallback":None,"fallback_after_s":0,"budget_cap_usd":None}}
r=[put(a,{"check":{"executor":"moon"}}),put(a,{"nosuchop":{"executor":"server"}}),put(b,ok),put(a,ok)]
sv.terminate(); assert r==[2,2,1,0], r
